step1_analysis.description: A fine-granularity power gating header circuit used to partition power supplies and reduce leakage in an SRAM array. It uses series PFETs to create a virtual VDD (N0) and includes bias and decoupling elements to manage power domains.

paper_reference.title: A 64Mb SRAM in 22nm SOI Technology Featuring Fine-Granularity Power Gating and Low-Energy Power-Supply-Partition Techniques for 37% Leakage Reduction

voltage_drop_active.description: Voltage drop across the header switch during active mode (VDD - V_virtual_VDD).

sky130_expected.calculation: I_load * R_on of series PFETs. With a 10k load, I ~= 140uA. R_on of two 5u/0.5u PFETs is roughly 2.9kOhm. Voltage drop = 140uA * 2.9kOhm ~= 0.4V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the load resistor and transistor sizing. The series stack increases the resistance compared to a single header.

turn_on_time.description: Time required for the virtual VDD to reach a functional level after the sleep signal is de-asserted.

sky130_expected.calculation: RC time constant of header R_on and load capacitance. Assuming minimal parasitic capacitance (~10fF), tau = 2.9kOhm * 10fF = 29ps. Dominated by input transition time.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Fast switching due to small parasitic capacitance in the testbench, though in a real SRAM array the load capacitance would be much larger.

leakage_power.description: Power consumed by the circuit in sleep mode (N7 = VDD).

sky130_expected.calculation: Subthreshold leakage of the series PFETs. For W=5u, leakage is roughly 10pA/um, so ~50pA. Power = 1.8V * 50pA = 90pW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Series stacked PFETs significantly reduce leakage (stack effect), which aligns with the paper's goal of leakage reduction.

active_power.description: Power consumed from the main supply during active mode.

sky130_expected.calculation: Dominated by the load resistor. I = V_N0 / 10k ~= 1.4V / 10k = 140uA. Power = 1.8V * 140uA = 252uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to the artificial load placed on the virtual VDD node in the testbench.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure active voltage drop, turn-on time, active power, and sleep leakage power of the power gating header.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Power Gating Circuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VN6 N6 0 1.8

* Sleep signal (active low to turn on VDDV)
VN7 N7 0 PULSE(1.8 0 5n 0.1n 0.1n 20n 40n)

* DUT
XM1 N1 N7 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N3 N6 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N3 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N7 N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N2 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N4 N3 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N5 LABEL_NET_1 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N5 N7 N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N4 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 N0 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}

* Loads to simulate SRAM array and peripheral logic
Rload0 N0 0 10k
Rload4 N4 0 10k
Rload5 N5 0 10k

.control
tran 0.1n 50n

* Measure active and sleep voltages on virtual VDD (N0)
meas tran v_vddv_active max v(N0)
meas tran v_vddv_sleep min v(N0)

* Measure turn-on time (delay from sleep falling to VDDV rising)
meas tran t_turn_on trig v(N7) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=1.2 rise=1

* Measure power consumption
meas tran pwr_active avg i(VVDD) from=10n to=20n
meas tran pwr_sleep avg i(VVDD) from=35n to=45n

let pwr_active_mw = -pwr_active * 1.8 * 1000
let pwr_sleep_uw = -pwr_sleep * 1.8 * 1000000

print v_vddv_active v_vddv_sleep t_turn_on pwr_active_mw pwr_sleep_uw
quit
.endc
